instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and crop the image to remove the outer edges, then save it as 'character_cropped.png'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png in GIMP, cropping it (using crop tool or Image > Crop to Selection), and saving as character_cropped.png. Evaluator checks that the output image has smaller dimensions than the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts image dimensions from both original and cropped files using PIL
Cropping logic is semantically correct: checks if either width OR height is smaller than original
Metric function properly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (receives rules dict directly)
Complete instruction coverage: verifies both cropping (dimension reduction) and file save (file path check)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts is_cropped boolean, metric compares against expected value
No postconfig needed: saved file persists on disk and getter reads from filesystem
Edge cases handled: returns None if files don't exist or can't be loaded
